subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Should `reload.accountIndexReloadPaths` be a contract declared by the external Weixin plugin and released in a pinned package, rather than metadata only available through OpenClaw's manifest fallback path?
rationale: The branch adds a plugin-facing reload capability but the loaded-plugin precedence means catalog metadata alone does not activate it for the normal production package; choosing the permanent authority for this contract affects external-plugin compatibility.

options.title: Make the plugin authoritative
options.body: Publish and pin a Weixin plugin version that declares the marker in its loaded ChannelPlugin contract, then retain the generic Gateway reader.

options.title: Merge catalog metadata at registration
options.body: Change core registration to merge catalog reload metadata into loaded plugins, accepting a broader catalog-to-runtime contract.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Leave the existing whole-channel behavior unchanged until the external-plugin contract has an owner-approved design.

recommendation.title: Make the plugin authoritative
recommendation.body: Publish and pin a Weixin plugin version that declares the marker in its loaded ChannelPlugin contract, then retain the generic Gateway reader.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work established the adjacent channel reload capability and conservative plugin opt-in model.
